architectureVerdict: Partial preservation: overall source layout survives; vent construction and some material/detail treatment do not preserve the accepted reference.
reviewer: animation_renderer agent; exact source composite, native reference, and actual front/back/gameplay Blender renders inspected
cameraAndViewport: Three recorded orthographic Blender Cycles views, 1280x1280, 48 samples. Elevated gameplay.png is a representative review camera, not live town-camera proof.

technical_import.reason: 49,992 triangles, one mesh/material, three embedded/packed 4096x4096 PBR maps. Original GLB unchanged; Blender import, save and three renders succeeded.

source_layout_identity.reason: Low broad yellow building, broad gray roof, right-hand red vent, four circular clerestory windows, two lower rectangular window groups, and central green entrance survive the export.

reference_construction_identity.reason: The closed metal ventilator cap in the native reference became a recessed bright-blue top that reads as an open vessel. Individual roof tiles also largely collapsed into softened horizontal bands.

door_anchor_estimate.reason: 155 green facade triangles produce a measured doorway at 0.500323 of asset width, matching the source central entrance at 0.5. Actual views confirm front +Z and centered green door.

integrated_warp_alignment.reason: No app edits in this bounded task; integration owner must align measured anchor to original source warp (16,13) and test entry.

proportions_and_scale.reason: Dimensions 0.961246 x 0.708144 x 0.473638 in Blender units; source units are normalized, not verified meters. Uniform integration scale remains to be reviewed.

material_response.reason: Portholes show exaggerated irregular reflective blobs, roof detail is soft, and yellow brick joints read as dense horizontal bands. Glazing remains opaque and one fused material prevents independent glass/metal treatment.

backside_completion.reason: Back render shows a closed rear volume and roof, with no duplicated door. Diagnostic UV-seam weld yields zero boundary/nonmanifold edges and zero degenerate faces.

backside_correctness.reason: Rear window groups and their black center panels are generated assumptions with no source/reference support. Black panels are a visible material/design inconsistency, not evidence of open mesh holes.

scene_readability_and_lighting.reason: Laboratory remains recognizable in the elevated view, but the roof and blue vent recess dominate. Actual town view needs independent review after integration.

motion_and_contact.reason: Static exterior asset; no door animation or laboratory interior in this bounded task.

defects.symptom: Solid capped red vent became an open-looking blue recess.
defects.consequence: Architectural construction no longer follows the inspected reference and reads as a container.
defects.nextAction: Locally remodel the vent cap and louvers in Blender from the reference, then re-export and re-render; do not submit another paid generation automatically.

defects.symptom: Roof tiles lose crisp transverse joints and merge into soft strips; brick detail flattens into horizontal banding.
defects.nextAction: Rebuild/material-repair repeatable roof and wall construction at the actual camera texel density.

defects.symptom: Blue opaque panes have distorted bright specular shapes; rear center panes are black.
defects.nextAction: Separate glazing material/geometry and specify a coherent reflection/interior response, with explicit rear-window design.

defects.symptom: Rear openings were invented from one source view.
defects.nextAction: Choose explicit rear requirements if those angles are accessible and review them as authored interpretation.

placement.coordinateFrame: glTF scene/root coordinates after node transforms, before runtime scale/centering. Not raw mesh accessor coordinates.

limitations: Candidate staging is permitted with status explicit; no photoreal acceptance.
3D geometry and unseen surfaces are authored/generated interpretations, not extracted ROM geometry.
Editable .blend is a fused triangulated candidate with packed maps and separate review stage, not a parametric building.
Door anchor is a texture/geometry estimate, not collision geometry.
No app edits, no additional generation retry, no creature generation.
nextAction: Integrate only as an explicitly labeled candidate for source-door testing. Repair vent cap and material/construction defects locally, then obtain independent runtime visual review.
